name: goaljaby-codex
description: Codex-native bridge from a PRD folder to Codex /goal — generates 5 review docs (VALIDATION/RECOVERY/PLAN/PROGRESS/goal-command) in the user's language (auto-detected; ko/en first-class with deterministic heading validation) plus a PLANS.md ExecPlan, enforces a 4,000-character compact with Korean+English OR protected-clause regex, inherits design references and kkirikkiri gates when present, then starts the native goal after human approval.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a PRD folder into review docs in your language plus an approval-triggered Codex goal
interface.longDescription: Package the Codex-native goaljaby skill that converts a PRD folder into five review documents (VALIDATION/RECOVERY/PLAN/PROGRESS/goal-command) in the user's language plus a PLANS.md ExecPlan, enforces a 4,000-character compact, inherits design references and multi-agent gate rules when present, shows a review summary in chat, and after a mandatory approval gate starts the native Codex goal.
defaultPrompt: Convert this PRD folder into review docs and a PLANS.md ExecPlan, then start the goal once I approve.
Use goaljaby to bridge my PRD into a Codex /goal-driven long-running session.
Prep VALIDATION/RECOVERY/PLAN/PROGRESS docs from my PRD and start the goal after review.
